nodes.label: build workflow
nodes.rationale: Verifies bun run build produces a usable dist/ (entry point plus type declarations) and that the committed DevTools UI bundle was generated from the sources in the tree; skips on docs-only, test-only and README changes so the actions queue stays focused.

nodes.label: build job
nodes.rationale: Builds with build:lib (tsc only) since #483. The old build was build:ui && tsc, so it regenerated the very file under test and any check after it passed by construction — using tsc alone removes that hazard structurally instead of relying on step order.

nodes.label: check:ui bundle-currency step
nodes.rationale: The generated bundle is committed on purpose so a fresh clone can typecheck, test and smoke without the UI build — which is exactly what made staleness invisible: the file is valid TypeScript whether or not its contents are current. It compares a source-hash rather than rebuilding and diffing bytes, because gzip stamps the OS into every member and every Bun bump moves the minifier (#521).

nodes.label: Least-privilege workflow permissions (#621)
nodes.rationale: Stated rather than inherited: the repository default is read-only today, but a settings flip would otherwise hand a write token to a job that installs and runs the whole dependency tree.
